purpose: Post-review supplementary analysis; not a new blind confirmation or model selection

group_bootstrap.interval: pointwise percentile paired source-group bootstrap of equal-group mean difference

sign_test.multiplicity: Holm across all 18 primary comparisons: two airports x three horizons x three comparisons

local_baseline: KAGC expanding chronological complete-source-group history; include only groups whose final forecast window ends before the next group's first cutoff; first group is warmup; retain original KBTP event thresholds; compare frozen predictions on identical eligible scenes

calibration.weighting: pooled scenes, descriptive; group-equal Brier also reported

constraints: Do not select groups by outcomes
No full-day or third-airport experiment in this revision
